blocks.text: Biochemistry science ki woh shaakh (branch) hai jo jaandaron (living organisms) mein paye jane wale chemical substances aur un ke reactions ka mutala (study) karti hai. Biological compounds bare aur pecheeda (complex) molecules hain, lekin in mein wahi functional groups hote hain jo saada organic compounds mein hote hain, jaise alcohol, amine, aldehyde, ketone, carboxylic acid, ester aur amide groups.

Is chapter mein zaroori biomolecules, yani carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids, parhe jayenge: un ki banawat (structure), un ke kaam (functions) aur cell ke andar un ka kirdar (role). In ke ilawa biochemical processes mein minerals aur enzymes ka kirdar bhi bataya jayega.

blocks.prompt: Is chapter mein parhi jane wali biomolecules ki chaar qismein batayein.
blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids.

items: Biochemistry: jaandaron ke chemical substances aur un ke reactions ka ilm.
Biomolecules mein aam functional groups: alcohol (–OH), amine (–NH₂), aldehyde aur ketone (C=O), carboxylic acid (–COOH), ester aur amide.
